lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features extend across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light superior edges and shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) are attached to the ventral region and trailing from the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
